Score Calibration MatrixLink

Rating BandScore RangeMeaningFounder Posture
Controlled90-100Business quality is strong and governable.Protect discipline and scale carefully.
Advancing80-89Business quality is healthy but still needs active founder pressure.Tighten weak areas before they grow.
Fragile70-79Activity is moving faster than quality in at least one critical area.Intervene, narrow exceptions, and open controls.
CriticalBelow 70Control quality is insufficient for safe scaling.Pause expansion, escalate, and correct before release.

Metric Normalization RulesLink

  • Use consistent periods, denominators, and definitions across all score categories.
  • Prefer quality ratios, controlled scores, and exception rates over raw activity counts when possible.
  • Mark any materially incomplete metric as provisional in the founder note.
  • Anchor any judgment-based score to the linked dashboard or source record.
  • Do not claim improvement if the underlying source layer is stale or low-confidence.
